name: Zenitsu Agatsuma
summary: Zenitsu Agatsuma is one of the main protagonists of Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba and a member of the Demon Slayer Corps. He was trained in Thunder Breathing by the former Thunder Hashira Jigoro Kuwajima. Although normally cowardly and lacking confidence, Zenitsu possesses extraordinary hearing, swordsmanship, physical ability, and combat instincts. After his training, he became capable of using Thunder Breathing's First Form at tremendous speeds and developed his own variations of the technique.
notes: Zenitsu's Awake/Post-Demon Slayer Training key. His Thunder Breathing greatly amplifies his speed and allows him to perform extremely fast sword attacks. His First Form, Thunderclap and Flash, can be further enhanced into Sixfold. His Awakened Power allows him to become significantly stronger and faster by remembering his master Jigoro Kuwajima, enabling him to surpass his normal speed and overwhelm the Spider Demon Brother despite being affected by poison. He can also fight while unconscious through his exceptional hearing and sensory perception.
